upgrade_description: Upgrade codemirror5 devDependency toolchain to latest compatible versions: rollup ^1.26.3 to 4.63.2, puppeteer ^1.20.0 to 25.10.0, @rollup/plugin-buble ^0.21.3 to 1.0.3, cm5-vim ^0.0.5 to 0.0.6. node-static 0.7.11 and blint ^1.1.2 already latest; no change. Migrate rollup.config.js to current Rollup 4 config API/plugin interfaces. Update test/run.js for Puppeteer 25 API changes including page.waitFor removal and headless mode changes. Do not migrate to CodeMirror 6.

breaking_changes: Rollup ^1.26.3 to 4.63.2 crosses major config/plugin API and CLI behavior boundaries; rollup.config.js is the direct build surface.
@rollup/plugin-buble ^0.21.3 to 1.0.3 crosses a major plugin package boundary and is invoked in every Rollup output config.
Puppeteer ^1.20.0 to 25.10.0 crosses many browser-launch/runtime changes, including headless mode behavior; test/run.js is the direct usage site.
No page.waitFor usage was found in the included paths; test/run.js already uses a custom page.evaluate polling loop.
cm5-vim ^0.0.5 to 0.0.6 affects generated keymap/vim.js through rollup.config.js copy target.
risk_summary.notes: No dependency from the Step 2a checklist crosses a listed boundary in this requested upgrade. node-static 0.7.11 and blint ^1.1.2 were found but are explicitly unchanged.

coverage_notes: GitNexus index for codemirror5 was available and current on 2026-09-14; GitNexus surfaced package.json, rollup.config.js, test/run.js, and test/lint.js file nodes, while exact line locations were captured with targeted Select-String because ripgrep returned no root-manifest matches in this shell. Excluded paths were not searched except for the explicitly allowed generated output keymap/vim.js. Repository scan found package.json and rollup.config.js only; no package-lock.json, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, XML/YAML/conf/ini service configs, or persistent database/cache/broker/search service declarations were found. User declared no external services; node-static is a throwaway local npm test server on port 3000, not a persistent external service.
